<image1>

Spaceflight is an important undertaking of high technology, high investment, and high risk that explores the mysteries of the universe, and it requires international cooperation. Because the task is urgent, a plane with an average speed of 1110 kilometers per hour flies from the Kennedy Space Center to the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center by the shortest route. About how many hours are needed?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: 甲 is near 80°W, 30°N, and 乙 is near 100°E, 40°N. Since their longitudes differ by 180°, take the nearest route along the great circle through the North Pole. Compute angular distance: from 30°N to 90°N is 60°, then from 90°N to 40°N is 50°, total 110°. Convert to distance: 110×111=12210 km. Divide by the speed in the text: 12210÷1110=11 hours.

推理：甲约为80°W，乙约为100°E，两地经度差为180°。按最近路程，应沿经过北极的大圆航线计算。甲从30°N到北极90°N为60°，再从北极到乙的40°N为50°，合计角距离为110°。地球大圆上1°约为111千米，所以距离约为110×111=12210千米。飞机平均时速为1110千米，所需时间为12210÷1110=11小时。

航天是一项高科技、高投入、高风险的探索宇宙奥秘的重要事业，需要国际协作。因任务紧急，一架平均时速为1110千米的飞机从肯尼迪航天中心按最近路程飞往酒泉卫星发射中心，约需多少小时？
